name: MonarchBlockEditor
title: BlockEditor
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField blocks (one MonarchRichTextEditorState each), with MonarchEditorToolbar, MonarchSlashMenu, MonarchDragHandle with androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu, androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox, MonarchCalloutBlock, MonarchToggleBlock, MonarchTableBlock, MonarchEmbedBlock and androidx.compose.foundation.text.contextmenu.modifier.appendTextContextMenuComponents
summary: A block document editor: paragraphs, headings, lists, checklists, quotes, code, callouts, toggles, tables and embeds, with a / menu, a handle per block to move or change it, a formatting toolbar and formats in the text selection menu.
whenToUse: For documents people build out of blocks, such as notes, specs, wiki pages and briefs, stored as a list of blocks.
whenNotToUse: For one formatted text such as a description or a comment use MonarchRichTextEditor; for plain text use MonarchTextField; to show a finished document without editing it, readOnly = true is enough.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable public fun MonarchBlockEditor(label: String, state: MonarchBlockEditorState, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, blocks: Set<MonarchBlockEditorBlockType> = MonarchBlockEditorBlockType.entries.toSet(), tools: List<List<MonarchEditorTool>> = MonarchBlockEditorDefaults.Tools, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, bubbleMenu: Boolean = true, dragHandles: Boolean = true, slashMenu: Boolean = true, slashItems: List<MonarchSlashMenuItem> = emptyList(), slashGroupOrder: List<String> = emptyList(), embedProviders: List<MonarchEmbedProvider> = MonarchEmbedProvider.Defaults, icons: Map<MonarchEditorTool, Painter> = emptyMap(), labels: MonarchBlockEditorLabels = MonarchBlockEditorLabels(), listState: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), onSlashItem: ((MonarchSlashMenuItem) -> Unit)? = null, onTool: ((MonarchEditorTool) -> Unit)? = null, onOpenLink: ((String) -> Unit)? = null)

@Stable public class MonarchBlockEditorState(blocks: List<MonarchBlockEditorBlock> = emptyList()) { val blocks: List<MonarchBlockEditorBlock>; val focusedBlockId: String?; val canUndo: Boolean; val canRedo: Boolean; fun setBlocks(blocks: List<MonarchBlockEditorBlock>); fun undo(); fun redo(); fun insertBlock(block: MonarchBlockEditorBlock, afterId: String? = focusedBlockId); fun updateBlock(block: MonarchBlockEditorBlock); fun moveBlock(id: String, offset: Int); fun duplicateBlock(id: String); fun deleteBlock(id: String); companion object { fun newId(): String; val Saver: Saver<MonarchBlockEditorState, Any> } }
@Composable public fun rememberMonarchBlockEditorState(blocks: List<MonarchBlockEditorBlock> = emptyList()): MonarchBlockEditorState

public sealed interface MonarchBlockEditorBlock { val id: String; val type: MonarchBlockEditorBlockType; data class Text(id: String, style: MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle = Paragraph, text: String = "", spans: List<MonarchRichTextSpan> = emptyList(), checked: Boolean = false); data class Callout(id: String, text: String = "", spans: List<MonarchRichTextSpan> = emptyList(), tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Info); data class Toggle(id: String, text: String = "", spans: List<MonarchRichTextSpan> = emptyList(), body: String = "", expanded: Boolean = true); data class Table(id: String, data: MonarchTableBlockData = MonarchTableBlockData.empty()); data class Embed(id: String, url: String = "", caption: String? = null) }
public enum class MonarchBlockEditorBlockType { Paragraph, Heading1, Heading2, Heading3, BulletedList, NumberedList, Checklist, Quote, Code, Callout, Toggle, Table, Embed }

public enum class MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle(val type: MonarchBlockEditorBlockType) { Paragraph, Heading1, Heading2, Heading3, BulletedList, NumberedList, Checklist, Quote, Code; val isList: Boolean; val isHeading: Boolean; companion object { fun of(type: MonarchBlockEditorBlockType): MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle? } }
public object MonarchBlockEditorDefaults { val Tools: List<List<MonarchEditorTool>> }

public class MonarchBlockEditorLabels(placeholder: String? = null, names: Map<MonarchBlockEditorBlockType, String> = emptyMap(), descriptions: Map<MonarchBlockEditorBlockType, String> = emptyMap(), groupText: String? = null, groupLists: String? = null, groupBlocks: String? = null, handle: ((block: String) -> String)? = null, moveUp: String? = null, moveDown: String? = null, duplicate: String? = null, delete: String? = null, turnInto: String? = null, tone: String? = null, neutralTone: String? = null, moved: ((block: String, position: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, toggleShow: String? = null, toggleHide: String? = null, toggleContent: String? = null, embedLink: String? = null, embedAdd: String? = null, toolbar: MonarchEditorToolbarLabels = MonarchEditorToolbarLabels(), slashMenu: MonarchSlashMenuLabels = MonarchSlashMenuLabels(), table: MonarchTableBlockLabels = MonarchTableBlockLabels(), embed: MonarchEmbedBlockLabels = MonarchEmbedBlockLabels())

options.name: label
options.description: The spoken name of the document, already localized. Show a visible title nearby.

options.name: state
options.description: The document, the block with the caret and the undo history. Create it with rememberMonarchBlockEditorState.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the editor. Give it a bounded height: the editor scrolls itself.

options.name: blocks
options.description: The kinds of block offered in the / menu, the toolbar, the shortcuts and the Turn into menu. Paragraphs are always offered; blocks of other kinds already in the document are still shown.

options.name: tools
options.description: The toolbar's tools in groups; an empty list for no toolbar. Custom tools go to onTool.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the document can be edited. Disabled shows the blocks in the disabled colors without the toolbar and the handles.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the document as read: text with links that open, callouts, toggles that open and close, tables and embeds; no fields, toolbar or handles.

options.name: bubbleMenu
options.description: Adds Bold, Italic, Strikethrough and Code to the system menu of selected text.

options.name: dragHandles
options.description: Shows the handle beside each block, which is dragged to move the block and tapped for its menu.

options.name: slashMenu
options.description: Opens the / menu when / is typed at the start of a text block.

options.name: slashItems
options.description: The app's entries of the / menu, after the built-in ones; their ids must not be the built-in ids.

options.name: slashGroupOrder
options.description: Group headings of the / menu in display order.

options.name: embedProviders
options.description: The sites an embed may frame; other links are shown as links.

options.name: icons
options.description: The icons of the toolbar's tools. A tool without one shows its name.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including those of the toolbar, the / menu, tables and embeds.

options.name: listState
options.description: The scroll state of the document.

options.name: onSlashItem
options.description: Receives the app's / menu entries after the typed command is removed; change the document with state.

options.name: onTool
options.description: Receives the custom tools of the toolbar.

options.name: onOpenLink
options.description: Opens a link of an embed outside the app; null uses the system browser.

states.name: editing
states.description: Each block is a text field at least 48dp high with its handle at the start; the toolbar acts on the block with the caret and shows its style and formats as on.

states.name: empty
states.description: A new document is one empty paragraph that shows "Write, or type / for blocks"; an empty block with the caret shows the placeholder (or the name of its kind).

states.name: slash menu
states.description: While / and a word are typed at the start of a text block, the / menu under the document lists the matching kinds; choosing one turns the block into it, or inserts a table or an embed.

states.name: block menu
states.description: A tap on a handle opens Move up, Move down, Duplicate, Turn into (the kinds that keep the text), Tone for a callout and Delete block.

states.name: dragging
states.description: While a handle is dragged, its block follows the finger with an accent outline and a shadow, the other blocks slide aside and the list scrolls at its edges; the move is made on release.

states.name: read only
states.description: Blocks are shown as text, callouts, toggles that open and close, tables and embeds, without fields, toolbar or handles; links open on a tap.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Blocks are shown in their fields with the disabled text color, without the toolbar and the handles.

appearance: Text uses the default text role (headings in the title, heading and subheading styles, quotes in the muted text role beside a strong border bar, code on the subtle background with a subtle border), placeholders the subtle text role, list markers the muted text role, checklist boxes the accent solid role; a dragged block has the surface fill, the accent border and a medium shadow, and Delete block is in the danger strong role. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web BlockEditor is one Tiptap (ProseMirror) document. Compose has no rich-text engine, so on Android each block is its own BasicTextField over a MonarchRichTextEditorState in a LazyColumn, and the document is a list of MonarchBlockEditorBlock values instead of HTML or Tiptap JSON; no conversion is shipped, so it is experimental until the interchange format is agreed across platforms, like MonarchRichTextEditor. Consequences: a selection stays inside one block (no selection or copy across blocks); undo is the editor's own history of the whole document, grouped by word while typing. On a phone the handle is a 48dp gutter beside every block instead of appearing on hover, a tap opens the block menu and a drag moves the block; the / menu is a strip under the document, above the keyboard, because Compose gives no caret rectangle; the web's selection bubble is items added to the system text selection menu. Not offered: columns (blocks side by side do not fit a phone; the document is already one column), images (Monarch takes pictures as Painters, and an editor that stores them needs the app's upload and loading; insert them through slashItems and the app's own UI), heading levels 4 to 6, nested lists, Tab to indent, the onEditorReady and editorRef handles, maxLength, mentions, HTML or JSON output and a hidden form field. A toggle's content is plain text. iOS has no BlockEditor entry yet; the names follow the web.
accessibility: Every block is a text field named by its kind ("Heading 1", "Bulleted list", "Numbered list 2"); headings are headings in editing and reading.

Each handle is one TalkBack element, a button named "Block actions" and the kind, that opens the block menu, with Move up and Move down as custom actions; Alt+Shift+Up and Down move the block from the keyboard.
Every move is announced through a polite live region: "Heading 1 moved to position 2 of 4."
A checklist item's checkbox is named by the item's text and is checked or not, and a ticked item is also struck through, so the state is not color alone.
Blocks, handles, checkboxes and buttons are at least 48dp high, also at the largest font size, and the document scrolls instead of cutting text.
The document list is named by label; the / menu announces the number of matches itself.
edgeCases: Return in a list or checklist item starts a new item; Return on an empty item turns it into a paragraph. Return in code adds a line.
Pasting several lines into a text block makes one block per line.

Backspace at the start of a heading, list item, quote, code, callout or empty toggle turns it into a paragraph; at the start of a paragraph it joins the paragraph to the block above, or deletes it when empty after a table or embed. Soft keyboards send Backspace on an empty field as a key event only on some devices.
Deleting the last block leaves one empty paragraph.
Blocks with repeated ids are given new ids when loaded.
The editor needs a bounded height; inside a vertically scrolling parent it throws, as every LazyColumn does.

examples.title: Document with outline
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(24.dp)) {
    @OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
    MonarchBlockEditor(
        label = {{label}},
        state = state,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1000.dp),
    )
    MonarchPageOutline(
        headings = listOf(
            MonarchPageOutlineHeading({{blocks.0.text}}, {{blocks.0.level}}, {{blocks.0.text}}),
            MonarchPageOutlineHeading({{blocks.2.text}}, {{blocks.2.level}}, {{blocks.2.text}}),
            MonarchPageOutlineHeading({{blocks.6.text}}, {{blocks.6.level}}, {{blocks.6.text}}),
            MonarchPageOutlineHeading({{blocks.8.text}}, {{blocks.8.level}}, {{blocks.8.text}}),
        ),
        onNavigate = {},
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        currentId = {{blocks.0.text}},
        stats = MonarchPageOutlineStats(words = {{outline.words}}, minutes = {{outline.minutes}}),
        labels = MonarchPageOutlineLabels(title = {{outline.title}}),
    )
}
examples.setupTemplate:
val state = rememberMonarchBlockEditorState(
    listOf(
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b0", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading1, {{blocks.0.text}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b1", text = {{blocks.1.text}}, spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Code, {{blocks.1.text}}.indexOf({{blocks.1.code}}), {{blocks.1.text}}.indexOf({{blocks.1.code}}) + {{blocks.1.code}}.length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b2", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, {{blocks.2.text}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b3", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Checklist, {{blocks.3.text}}, checked = {{blocks.3.checked}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b4", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Checklist, {{blocks.4.text}}, checked = {{blocks.4.checked}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Callout("b5", {{blocks.5.text}}, tone = {{blocks.5.tone|tone}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b6", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, {{blocks.6.text}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b7a", text = {{blocks.7.columns.0.text}}, spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Bold, 0, {{blocks.7.columns.0.bold}}.length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b7b", text = {{blocks.7.columns.1.text}}, spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Bold, 0, {{blocks.7.columns.1.bold}}.length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b8", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, {{blocks.8.text}}),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Table(
            "b9",
            MonarchTableBlockData.of(
                listOf(
                    listOf({{blocks.9.rows.0.0}}, {{blocks.9.rows.0.1}}),
                    listOf({{blocks.9.rows.1.0}}, {{blocks.9.rows.1.1}}),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Toggle("b10", {{blocks.10.text}}, body = {{blocks.10.body}}, expanded = {{blocks.10.open}}),
    ),
)
examples.setup:
val state = rememberMonarchBlockEditorState(
    listOf(
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b0", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading1, "Project brief"),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b1", text = "Type / on an empty line to add a block, or drag the handle beside a block to move it.", spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Code, "Type / on an empty line to add a block, or drag the handle beside a block to move it.".indexOf("/"), "Type / on an empty line to add a block, or drag the handle beside a block to move it.".indexOf("/") + "/".length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b2", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, "Goals"),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b3", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Checklist, "Agree on scope", checked = true),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b4", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Checklist, "Share the timeline", checked = false),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Callout("b5", "Decisions are recorded at the end of this page.", tone = MonarchTone.Info),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b6", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, "Options"),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b7a", text = "Option A: phased rollout.", spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Bold, 0, "Option A".length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b7b", text = "Option B: single release.", spans = listOf(MonarchRichTextSpan(MonarchRichTextMark.Bold, 0, "Option B".length))),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Text("b8", MonarchBlockEditorTextStyle.Heading2, "Timeline"),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Table(
            "b9",
            MonarchTableBlockData.of(
                listOf(
                    listOf("Phase", "Dates"),
                    listOf("Design", "Weeks 1–2"),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchBlockEditorBlock.Toggle("b10", "Background", body = "Notes from the earlier review.", expanded = false),
    ),
)

parityExceptions.reason: The block kind is expressed by the native block constructor (heading, text, task list, callout, table, toggle), not by a string; the type only selects the web HTML builder
parityExceptions.convention: none: structural, the kind is the constructor
